{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the Galactic Rim|the [[Galactic Frontier/Legends|Galactic Frontier]]}}
{{Quote|The edge of the galaxy!|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>}}
The '''Galactic Rim''' was the name given to the edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was known to be less luminous as the [[Star/Legends|stars]] began to fade out. 

==Description==
{{Quote|Beyond this point, there is much that is not known. Anything could happen.|Charza Kwinn|<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>}}
[[File:BattlestarPelagia-EE1.png|thumb|right|250px|An Imperial shipyard in the Galactic Rim.]]
The Galactic Rim was located on the very edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was remote, with not much was known about it. It also lacked any commerce centres and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activities,<ref name="RP" /> and was known for being slightly less luminous as the [[Star/Legends|stars]] faded out.<ref name="EE1" /> 

==History==
===Incoming invasion===
{{Quote|There's an invasion coming. A massive assault force of dark ships, shadowy figures, and weapons of great power, based on organic technology of a sort we've never seen before. We believe these Far Outsiders, as we call them, already have a foothold at the far edge of the galaxy, and even now have scouting parties seeking information on worlds and peoples to conquer...|Kinman Doriana|<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
Information of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] activity within the galaxy was scarce, but the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], who termed them "Far Outsiders", was fully aware of them [[Praetorite Vong|establishing]] a [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|foothold]] in the edge of the galaxy and that their scouting parties were active along with a possible distant threat of invasion.<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|We’ve got about ninety-five percent of the Alliance fleet cruising the Galactic Rim, and going nowhere fast.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="EE1" />}}
By [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], it was the location of a vast [[Unidentified Imperial shipyard|Imperial shipyard]] used by the [[Dark Empire]] which came under [[Siege of an Imperial Galactic Rim shipyard|siege]] from [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces.<ref name="EE1">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]]</ref>
